title.en: Runaway, and the distance to the break that does not couple in
title.zh: 失控与不耦合入的断裂距离

statement.zh: 每个经耦合、其余交换固定的策略保持支持就永不动用只经阈耦合入它的较多储量；对这样的储量，断裂之前，断裂还有多远不耦合入。
statement.en: Every policy through the couplings, with the rest of the exchange fixed, that keeps its support leaves unused any larger stock coupled into it by threshold only; for such a stock, how far off the break is does not couple in before the break.

laws.zh: 形成 g 的策略经其耦合，是指凡两个流直到某步经 g 的耦合无别，它在耦合入 g 的每个条件上的取用与给予在两个流中相同；其余固定，是指其他形成在耦合入 g 的条件上的交换每步相同；两个流在场的形成相同时，两者合起来就是交换随耦合入者。
laws.en: A formation g's policy goes through its couplings when, wherever the two flows have been alike through g's couplings up to a step, its take from and give to every condition coupled into g are alike in the two flows; the rest is fixed when every other formation's exchange on the conditions coupled into g is alike at every step; with the same formations present, the two give exchange following what couples in.

laws.zh: 对每个经耦合、其余固定的策略，在场的形成相同、在耦合入 g 的条件上逐步平衡、起始只在只经阈耦合入 g 的储量上不同且第二个网中高 d 时：第一个网每步都支持 g，储量就每步都高 d，两网每步都经 g 的耦合无别。
laws.en: For every policy through the couplings with the rest fixed, the same formations present and balance at each step on what couples into g, the starts differing only in a stock coupled into g by threshold only, d higher in the second web: where the first web supports g at every step, the stock stands d higher and the webs are alike through g's couplings at every step.

laws.zh: 同样的策略、其余、在场与平衡之下，第二个网起始在耦合入 g 者上不低、在经水平耦合入 g 者上相同，而耦合入 g 之条件上的差别在某步之前已改变时，第一个网并非此前每步都支持 g。
laws.en: Under the same policy, rest, presence and balance, where the second web starts at least as high on what couples into g and alike on what couples into g by level, and a difference on a condition coupled into g has changed by a step, the first web did not support g at every earlier step.

laws.zh: 把储量 c 每步抬高 d、其余不变的网不低于原网，支持原网所支持的，在别的条件上相同；原网依存之处它也依存，流在一个家族上平衡，在其上也平衡。
laws.en: The web with stock c raised by d at every step, all else as it is, stands at least as high, supports whatever the web supports and stands alike elsewhere; it is dependent where the web is, and a flow balancing on a family balances there on it.

laws.zh: 在网支持 g 的每一步，只经阈耦合入 g 的储量的抬高，两网经 g 的耦合无别；储量经水平耦合入时，任何正的抬高每步都显出。
laws.en: At every step at which the web supports g, the web with a stock coupled into g by threshold only raised is alike through g's couplings; with the stock coupled in by level, every positive raise shows at every step.

laws.zh: c 只经阈耦合入 g、到视界 u 为止只有 c 的所需可能不满足时，c 的某个抬高（证明中以到 u 为止的所需之和）在原网支持 g 的每一步经 g 的耦合无别，并在 u 之前每步都支持 g：断裂之前，断裂还有多远不耦合入。
laws.en: Where c couples into g by threshold only and c is the only requirement of g that may be unmet up to a horizon u, some raise of c (in the proof, by the sum of the needs up to u) is alike through g's couplings at every step at which the web supports g and supports g at every step up to u: before the break, how far off it is does not couple in.

laws.zh: SupportDrawn 中较低的网在第三步不支持形成，一个抬高在较低的网支持它的每一步经其耦合无别，在第三步支持它，流在其上平衡。
laws.en: In SupportDrawn the lower web fails the formation at the third step, and a raise is alike through its couplings at every step at which the lower web supports it, supports it at the third step and keeps the flow balanced.

hypotheses.zh: 平衡只在耦合入的条件上逐步假设（Flow.BalancesOn）；策略经耦合与其余固定是给出的假设，由它们推出交换随耦合入者；他者回应什么是给出的。
hypotheses.en: Balance is assumed only on the conditions coupled in, at each step (Flow.BalancesOn); the policy going through the couplings and the rest being fixed are supplied hypotheses, from which exchange following what couples in is derived; what others respond to is supplied.

hypotheses.zh: break_not_bounded 另设：g 不观察 c，到视界为止只有 c 的所需可能不满足；这是局部条件。
hypotheses.en: break_not_bounded further assumes that g does not observe c and that c is the only requirement that may be unmet up to the horizon, a local condition.

hypotheses.zh: 离散的步（从第 0 步计）；自然数的水平、所需与数量；条件与形成上的判定相等只用于分情形。
hypotheses.en: Discrete steps, counted from step 0; natural-number levels, needs and amounts; decidable equality of conditions and formations is used only to split cases.

does_not_show.zh: 这些规律不推出形成汲取多于更新、想要保持支持、形成策略。
does_not_show.en: The laws do not derive that a formation draws more than is renewed, wants to keep its support or forms a policy.

does_not_show.zh: 回路与增益没有定义，失控仍是读法，这里给的是它所依的两条定理。
does_not_show.en: Loops and gain are not defined, so a runaway remains a reading; what is given here are the two theorems it rests on.

does_not_show.zh: 抬高的世界用同一个流，断裂之后它不必是形成所会做的。
does_not_show.en: The raised world uses the same flow, which after the break need not be what the formation would do.

does_not_show.zh: 近乎定义：抬高的世界经耦合无别，因为存量不在经水平耦合入者之中。
does_not_show.en: Near-definitional: the raised world is alike through the couplings because the stock is not among what couples in by level.

does_not_show.zh: 成立是因为按假设存量不被观察；存量被观察之处，断裂常可预先看到，如临界转变的早期预警信号所示（Scheffer et al., Nature 2009）。
does_not_show.en: Holds because the stock is unobserved by hypothesis; where it is observed, a break can often be seen coming, as early-warning signals of critical transitions show (Scheffer et al., Nature 2009).

detail.zh: 其余固定是必要的：他者回应储量本身时，较高的储量可以先终结形成（Attracting.higher_breaks_first），T5 的策略形式不成立。
detail.en: The rest being fixed is needed: where others respond to the stock itself, a higher stock can end the formation first (Attracting.higher_breaks_first), and T5 over policies fails.

next_delta.zh: 他者回应储量时的策略形式；带误差的量度。
next_delta.en: The policy form where others respond to the stock; measurement with error.

correspondence.zh: Ren 的“wisdoms to avoid run away feedbacks”；testing-within-registration 把失控读作在一种不见之中运行的回路，并标为启发；experiment-needs-return 之后 AI 提议在策略的层面陈述，Ren 答“no extra review needed, merge, then continue”。读法（AI 的，依 Ren 的交托采用）：失控是这样的回路：断裂之前，经它自身的耦合，世界与储量多出任意多的世界无别；它的策略不能用上只经阈耦合入它的余量；要避免它而又不放弃所有的，需要量度、模型（理）或另一形成的耦合；合于 Ren 10 月 4 日“理须调节心，使其正反馈循环不失控”。
correspondence.en: Ren's “wisdoms to avoid run away feedbacks”; testing-within-registration read a runaway as a loop running inside a blindness and marked it a heuristic; after experiment-needs-return the AI proposed stating it at the level of policies, and Ren answered “no extra review needed, merge, then continue”. Readings (the AI's, adopted on Ren's delegation): a runaway is a loop through whose own couplings, before the break, the world is alike with a world with as much more stock as one likes; its policy cannot use a margin coupled into it by threshold only; avoiding it without forgoing what is there needs measurement, a model (理) or another formation's couplings; this reads Ren's words of 4 October that reason must regulate the heart so that its positive feedback loop does not run out of control.

detail.zh: 复用 Flow.ExchangeFollows、Flow.subthreshold_alike_always 与 Flow.difference_changes_after_divergence；增量是策略的层面：经耦合的策略加其余交换固定推出交换随耦合入者。
detail.en: Reuses Flow.ExchangeFollows, Flow.subthreshold_alike_always and Flow.difference_changes_after_divergence; the delta is the level of policies: a policy through the couplings with the rest of the exchange fixed gives exchange following what couples in.

output.en: The laws of differences below the threshold.

conditions.en: Balance; exchange following what couples in.

input.zh: 只经阈耦合入时抬高不显出；经水平耦合入时显出。
input.en: A raise coupled in by threshold only does not show; coupled in by level, it does.

detail.zh: 复用 Flow.BalancesOn：平衡只在耦合入的条件上逐步假设，抬高保持它。
detail.en: Reuses Flow.BalancesOn: balance is assumed only on the conditions coupled in, and raising keeps it.

output.zh: 一步上在一个家族上的平衡。
output.en: Balance on a family across one step.

detail.zh: 那里储备推迟终结而不逃脱它；这里储备推迟多久不耦合入。
detail.en: There a reserve defers the end and does not escape it; here how long it defers it does not couple in.

detail.zh: 要知道自己的动作造成什么，需要返回与关于何者无关的模型；这里经支持的耦合连断裂的距离也不给。
detail.en: Knowing what one's own act does needs a return and a model of what is irrelevant; here coupling through support does not even give the distance to the break.

detail.zh: 回答其下一步中“一般地定义回路并把失控陈述为定理”，在具有给定耦合强度的交换律上：回路是经正强度的耦合回到出发条件的链，到达回路者每圈至少乘以一加其强度之积（carried_runaway）；所失控的是能到达的最大差别，由携带之律达到。这里的失控是保持支持的策略，两者的连接仍是下一步。
detail.en: Answers the item of its next step asking to define a loop in general and state a runaway as a theorem, for laws of exchange with given coupling strengths: a loop is a chain of couplings of positive strength back to where it started, and what reaches it is multiplied every time around by at least one plus the product of its strengths (carried_runaway); what runs away is the most difference that can arrive, attained by the carrying law. The runaway here is a policy keeping support, and connecting the two stays a next step.

detail.zh: 这里失控的断裂在其前不耦合入；那里使之失控的回路的形成也不在它所携带的量中显出，能承载它的是耦合入耦合本身者。
detail.en: Here a runaway's break does not couple in before it; there the formation of the loop that runs away does not show in the amounts it carries either: what carries it is what the couplings themselves couple into.

detail.zh: 在一个律中：回路在所读之内，在读增长之处形成；只在储量低于阈值时才读它的律，断裂之前没有经过储量的回路，回路在断裂处形成。
detail.en: Within one law: loops lie within what is read and form where reading grows; for a law reading a stock only below a threshold there is no loop through the stock before the break, and the loop forms at the break.

detail.zh: 观察是从所观察者出发的所读路线：差别只往下游去，储量只经形成所读的、在储量下游的水平耦合入它；路线由闭合而形成。
detail.en: Observation is a route of readings from what is observed: a difference goes only downstream, and a stock couples into a formation only through a level it reads downstream of the stock; a route forms by closing.
